summary: Recent changes in the Canvas area of Firefox focus on enhancing the WebGL (Web Graphics Library) implementation, which is crucial for rendering interactive graphics in web applications. Key updates include improving how numbers are handled in the code, transitioning to standard C++ features that foster better performance and cleaner code. Additionally, support for Metal ANGLE (a graphics abstraction layer for macOS) has been integrated, enhancing WebGL performance on Apple devices. Notably, the **_WEBGL_compressed_texture_pvrtc_** feature has been disabled across all platforms, which could help streamline graphics rendering by removing less commonly used formats. These changes aim to improve the overall efficiency and reliability of graphical content on the web.
